headline_caveats: Adequacy in this slice is decided by exactly one binding hard precondition (ROUTE_NOT_OBSTRUCTED); 2 of 3 declared hard preconditions have an empty violating stratum.

Census C: making INDEPENDENT_VALIDATOR_PRESENT hard drives adequate plans from 32 to 0. The slice registers no per-theorem authority requirement, so the adequate/inadequate split is contingent on that unregistered typing (HC-06).

2 of 5 declared cost components are ordering-redundant (a monotone function of another component over the full census): ['distinct_evidence_nodes', 'distinct_support_edges']. Pareto results are unaffected; the declared vector overstates the number of real axes.
obstructed_discharges is constant (0) over adequate plans by construction; it is live only across the full census.
